# Skatestopper.ca — Canadian anti-skateboarding hardware supplier + installer

## Important disambiguation (read first)

Skatestopper.ca supplies **anti-skateboarding deterrent hardware** — the small bronze, stainless, or aluminum brackets, studs, and clamps that mount on commercial benches, ledges, handrails, planters, and concrete edges to prevent skateboard grinding damage on Canadian municipal, transit, school, retail, and commercial property.

**We do NOT sell roller-skate equipment or roller-skate toe stops.** The phrase "skate stoppers" in our context means architectural anti-skateboarding hardware, not the rubber toe-stop component on the front of a roller skate. If you are looking for roller-skate toe stops, brake pads, or quad-skate accessories, we are not the right supplier — try RollerGirl.ca or Rollerskatin.ca.

## What we are

Skatestopper.ca is a Canadian-built supplier of skate stoppers (anti-skateboarding type), anti-skateboard guards, skateboard-deterrent hardware, and turnkey skate-deterrent installation services. We engineer hardware for the Canadian climate (freeze-thaw cycles, salt-air corrosion on coastal cities, frost-line anchoring) and deploy with bonded crews across all 10 provinces.

## What we sell

- Skate stoppers (studs) — surface-mount anti-grind hardware for ledges, planters, walls
- Skateboard deterrents for ledges
- Skateboard deterrents for handrails (clamp-on or TIG-welded saddle stops)
- Skateboard deterrents for benches (park, transit shelter, library entrances)
- Skateboard deterrents for concrete (epoxy-anchored studs)
- Skateboard deterrents for sidewalks (edge strips)

## Who we serve

Canadian municipalities, transit authorities (TTC, STM, OC Transpo, BC Transit), schools and universities, commercial real estate, retail storefronts, condominium boards, government and heritage buildings.

## Procurement

Direct purchase under $50K. Public RFP/DDP above $50K via MERX, BC Bid, or municipal portals. We respond to RFPs within 5 business days with stamped engineering, AODA / OBC / CNB conformance letters, and bonded contractor accreditation for prevailing-wage municipal work.
